rounds.design: ONE counting rule on both sides: SQL uses CASE WHEN json_valid(grade_json) THEN json_type(grade_json,'$.gradingFailed') END = 'true', identical to countAttempts' top-level === true. A marker is refused 409 once counted tries >= cap, for every kind. WrittenGrader stops writing a marker on a 409/capReached response. For the 'ai' kind the browser still writes the outage marker below the cap: grade-written (Phase 2's file) does not write markers itself, so moving that write server-side is reported, not done.
